rules:
Input contains a single line containing a string s (1  ≤  |s|  ≤  105) — the text on the front page of the newspaper without spaces and punctuation marks. |s| is the length of the string s.

The string s contains lowercase and uppercase English letters, i.e. $$s_i \in \{a,b,\ldots,z,A,B,\ldots,Z\}$$. Unique result under retained statement; 727A inverse operations have disjoint parity and determine one path. Independent audit required.
